policy: Editorial navigation groups based on primary definitions, explicit anchors, parts of speech and documented neighbours. Proximity is not a synonym, root or etymology claim. Positions within each cluster are preserved; clusters and regions are packed apart. Spelling-dictionary words join the topic of their meaning or base word, else a word-formation group.
notes: Grouping is approximate and can be revised. Polysemous words have one primary map location. All earlier headwords are retained, each at its exact offset from its cluster centre; clusters move as a whole when the map is packed. New editorial words carry topic links only; no inflections have been added. Coordinate depth is a visual treatment, not linguistic distance.
